event.title: fix: Run release-please workflow only in jekyll/jekyll repo
event.body: This is a 🐛 bug fix. ## Summary The `release-please.yml` workflow doesn't make sense in forked repositories. Let's restrict its execution to jekyll/jekyll only. I did not expect a "workflow failed" notification soon after catching up with the upstream in my forked repo: ## Context
event.diff:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/release-please.yml b/.github/workflows/release-please.yml
index 6ad9c598870..a869cd727f7 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/release-please.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/release-please.yml
@@ -11,6 +11,7 @@ permissions:
 
 jobs:
   release-please:
+    if: ${{ github.repository == 'jekyll/jekyll' }}
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
     outputs:
       release_created: ${{ steps.release.outputs.release_created }}

index 07d70426967..a88313a4a7c 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/spelling.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/spelling.yml
@@ -65,7 +65,7 @@ jobs:

     - name: check-spelling

linked_issues.title: Issue with highlighting load tags for Django code
linked_issues.body:
###### I am using Jekyll 3.1.1 on Mac OS X 10.11.2 and I am using Rouge for syntax highlighting. In my markdown file, I am intend to highlight the following code ``` jinja {% load pipeline %} {% block title %}Build with the Github API{% endblock %} {% stylesheet 'yokogao' %}
{% block content %} {% endblock %}
{% block extra_scripts %} {% endblock %} ``` When I run `jekyll serve` it returns the following error: ``` ➜ test-site git:(master) ✗ jekyll serve --profile Configuration file: /Users/raybesiga/Projects/test-site/_config.yml Source: /Users/raybesiga/Projects/test-site Destination: /Users/raybesiga/Projects/test-site/_site Incremental build: disabled. Enable with --incremental Generating... Liquid Exception: Liquid syntax error: Unknown tag 'load' in /Users/raybesiga/Projects/test-site/_posts/2016-02-23-basic-django-app-github-api.markdown jekyll 3.1.1 | Error: Liquid syntax error: Unknown tag 'load' ``` I expected this to work as expected but not sure why it is raising an error. Any advise and help will be highly appreciated
